verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents built-in physics powered by ammo.js, a WebAssembly port of Bullet, used through rigidbody, collision and joint components. The same components work in the Editor, the standalone Engine, React and Web Components, so rigid bodies and collision shapes are clearly part of the core engine. Missing for 10: raycast support is not evidenced, there is no evidence on whether ammo.js works out of the box or needs separate setup, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of physics behaviour.
